d:
For abandoned dogs, a second chance can mean the difference between a life of uncertainty and a future filled with love. At Villalobos Rescue Center, Tia Torres and her team take on challenging dog rescue missions, helping injured, sick and neglected pit bulls receive the care and attention they deserve. Each rescue comes with its own struggles, but every dog has the chance to begin again.
Watch Pit Bulls & Parolees, Season 11, Episodes 13, 4, 18, 1, 9, 15, 7 and 2, on Animal Planet India.
